Topic 7

Trigonometry

7 lessons · Assessment: CT#6 (with Probability) · Term 3 weeks 7–8

The interactive lessons for this topic are still being built. This page shows what the course covers, taken from the handbook.

7 lessons: 6.1, 6.2

6.1 Textbook pp. 392–393
  • Interpret and use three-figure bearings.
  • Measure clockwise from the North, i.e. 000° – 360°.
6.2 Textbook pp. 394–405
  • Apply Pythagoras’ theorem and the sine, cosine and tangent ratios for acute angles to the calculation of a side or of an angle of a right-angled triangle.
  • Angles will be quoted in degrees. Answers should be written in degrees and decimals to one decimal place.
